extraction.name: Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI)
extraction.description: A multimodal benchmark to evaluate the capability of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in recognizing conflicting commands. It comprises 20,000 conflicts, evenly distributed between language and vision paradigms.
extraction.creator: Jin Gao, Lei Gan, Yuankai Li, Yixin Ye, Dequan Wang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Constructed using the AutoCreate framework, which leverages programs and large language models. It starts from manually input seeds and maintains a seed pool. During each cycle, it includes a language loop and a visual loop, each consisting of a generator and a decorator. A cleaner excludes data that does not meet the standards. The data is fed into the seed pool for the next round after a quality check by human experts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: ImageNet dataset (for SemanticConflict), manually input seeds, and code/other datasets.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The Decorator creates self-contradictions in the generated data. For FigureConflict, numerical data is manipulated by changing the maximum value to the minimum value. For SemanticConflict, the correct label in questions is substituted with a similar but different object. For GeometricConflict, descriptions of attributes are exchanged.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The Cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards. An LLM agent is used to judge whether answers to generated questions are unique (for ForbbidenConflict).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human experts rigorously checked the quality of the AutoCreate-generated dataset. Subsets (SCI-Core, SCI-Base) were selected manually.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Both human experts and LLMs are involved in double-checking the quality of the generated dataset.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Provides a standardized platform to assess and enhance LMMs' ability to navigate conflicting instructions, advancing human-computer interaction. Promotes inclusivity in AI research. Fosters trust and reliability in AI systems by improving dissonance detection.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Only includes language-language and vision-language paradigms (lacks other modalities). No fine-grained control is introduced to determine the conflict degree. No detailed study on the attention mechanism of large multimodal models when confronted with conflict instructions.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing, Evaluation (Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models against self-contradictory instructions)
